name: Milvus
model: Collections with a schema of vector and scalar fields; filtered, hybrid (dense plus sparse/BM25) and multi-vector search over gRPC/REST
engine_note: Many indexes (HNSW, IVF variants, DiskANN, GPU CAGRA, SCANN-style); segments and indexes in object storage (S3/MinIO), WAL in Woodpecker/Kafka/Pulsar
consistency: Per-entity writes; no multi-entity transactions documented. Four read consistency levels (Strong, Bounded staleness, Session, Eventually); default is bounded staleness, so a search can miss very recent writes. Durability comes from the WAL service.
scaling: Fully disaggregated: stateless query, data and streaming nodes scale out independently on Kubernetes; data and indexes in object storage; etcd holds metadata. Milvus Lite runs embedded for prototypes.
version_note: 3.0.0 released 2026-07-29 ('Milvus 3.0.0 is officially released!'); 2.6.x still patched (2.6.25 on 2026-09-29).
reach: Reach for it at hundreds of millions to billions of vectors, when you want to scale ingest and query separately and pick from many index types, including GPU and on-disk.
avoid: Avoid for a few million vectors or a small team: a full cluster is many components (etcd, object store, WAL, several node types) to operate.
escape: It stores billions of vectors in object storage with separately scaled compute, beyond one Postgres.
chat: Embeddings of every message across all users at very large scale, partitioned by tenant.
notes: Consistency quote: 'The default consistency level in Milvus is bounded staleness.' Architecture quotes: 'Object storage stores snapshot files of logs, index files for scalar and vector data, and intermediate query results.'; Woodpecker uses 'a cloud-native, zero-disk design that writes directly to object storage.'; worker nodes are stateless 'thanks to separation of storage and computation'. Index list: architecture doc says built on 'Faiss, HNSW, DiskANN, and SCANN'; GPU CAGRA named from Milvus index docs (not re-fetched this session). Multi-entity transactions: no statement found on the consistency page, so recorded as 'none documented'. Milvus is an LF AI and Data Foundation project; Zilliz is the main company. Milvus Lite (embedded Python) is why 'embedded' is in deploy; embedded flag kept false because the main product is a server. No Jepsen analysis.
